asset_role: visual-only tangent-space live-water normal; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic Patagonian river-flow tangent-space normal with multiscale downstream and cross-current structure
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable PBR game texture for an Unreal Engine whitewater river material. Primary request: create a seamless square tangent-space RGB normal map for the cold high-volume Futaleufu River in Patagonia, at roughly 0.25 to 4 meter surface-detail scales. Subject: physically plausible irregular flow-aligned river ripples with broad stretched current ridges, smaller cross-current interference, subtle eddy dimples, and non-repeating turbulent variation; strong enough to catch realistic specular light but not sharp ocean waves. Style/medium: production-quality tangent-space normal map, neutral flat-blue base centered near RGB 128,128,255, with red and green slope variation and blue remaining dominant. Composition/framing: orthographic top-down texture only, fills the entire square, perfectly seamless on all four edges, no single focal feature. Constraints: normal-map data only; no water color, no foam, no riverbank, no rocks, no horizon, no perspective, no baked lighting, no shadows, no highlights, no text, no logos, no watermark; avoid regular sine bands, cells, spirals, capsule streaks, and obvious tiling seams.
limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Futaleufu surface photography.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
It may modulate only solver-owned wet geometry and cannot create hydraulic features.
In-engine visual and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
